findings.observation: The sheet retains the red muscular horned demon, paired swept dark horns, dark spiked armor, skull belt/chains, attached tail and large iron axe. No lava-fist or white-palette substitution is visible. This does not approve mythic boss quality.

Noses and toes point screen right and only the near eye is readily visible, so the head reads strongly in profile. However a broad front chest/abdomen plane and the full frontal skull-belt face remain visible rather than being hidden or edge-on. This does not satisfy the requested pure right-flank camera.

observations.observation: The foreground/near armored leg descends forward to the lowest flat claw/toe plant on screen right. The other leg trails backward to screen left with its foot lifted.

The foreground/near armored leg again descends forward to the lowest flat claw/toe plant on screen right. The trailing far foot is again lifted behind to screen left. The shin/armor depth order and low-toe silhouette match the same support side as phase0.

findings.conclusion: The top pair does not expose a far-LEFT flat toeplant with a raised near-RIGHT knee at phase3. The observed pattern supports the same near-leg plant being repeated, rather than an independently established anatomical RIGHT/LEFT support swap. No complete six-phase gait approval is justified.

findings.observation: The near hand continuously carries the axe and the other claw remains empty across the six figures; no whole-body mirror or obvious hand swap is visible. Anatomical RIGHT ownership follows the intended near-side assignment; this is a static appearance observation only.

No obvious missing horn, extra arm/leg or severe cut-off weapon/body part is visible in the privately viewed source. The parent already reports a strict six-pose geometry pass; that does not repair the camera/support failures.
